title: Stronger together: a cross-SIG perspective on improving drug development

content.abstract_summary: A correspondence article summarizing the missions of all 5 ISoP SIGs (QSP, MCS, SxP, Clin PMx, PMxP) and arguing for cross-SIG collaboration within MIDD. Uses the inaugural cross-SIG session at ACoP14 (2023) as a case study. Provides a table of SIG founding dates, membership sizes, working groups, and websites, and a diagram mapping each SIG's methods to the MIDD framework with AI/ML as a cross-cutting theme.
key_findings: As of July 2024, ISoP has 5 SIGs: QSP (founded 2014, 200+), MCS (founded 2017, 70+), SxP (founded 2016, 200+), Clin PMx (founded 2017), PMxP (founded 2024, ~50)
MCS SIG's four working groups: Modeling Delays in PKPD; Optimal Control; Sensitivity Analysis/Uncertainty Quantification; AI/Machine Learning
AI/ML is treated as a cross-SIG theme (shown at base of the MIDD diagram) rather than the exclusive domain of any one SIG
Cross-SIG collaboration demonstrated at ACoP14 (2023): three examples illustrated mathematical/computational approaches central to MIDD from QSP, MCS, and SxP perspectives

Overlapping interests include AI/ML methods, data generation, covariate selection, model evaluation, package development, and ethical AI — areas where collaboration rather than duplication is essential
datasets_referenced: TransCelerate BioPharma Historical Trial Data Sharing Initiative
limitations: Sections on each SIG are high-level; technical depth on how MCS differentiates on AI/ML is not provided
Published in early 2025; the AI/ML SIG (launched Dec 2023) is not mentioned, understating the competitive landscape

extracted_claims.text: "The potential of AI/ML methodologies to transform drug discovery and development is at the forefront of our entire industry. As we attempt to identify how and where we can take advantage of opportunities from AI/ML, it is imperative that we work together and exchange knowledge."
